text:
Alex Chen: Legal asked for reproducible evidence packages for tenant audits — not just raw logs. Need signed assertions that show model version, route, and BYOK handshake.
Maya Patel: Clarify: signed assertions per-request plus raw logs ok? Any format preference?
Jordan Lee: Plan: (1) raw logs 30d, (2) compact signed evidence per request 365d, index by request_id, (3) legal-hold blobs 7y+ (no index).
Samir Rao: Evidence blob fields: request_id, timestamp, model_version, route_info, signature, and for BYOK a key_thumbprint + handshake_token.
Luis Gomez: Security: no plaintext keys. Store KMS key ID and wrapped-key thumbprint only. Validator must reject any package containing key material.
Maya Patel: GA must-haves: export API for tenant/time range, signed blobs, BYOK handshake tokens, validator that scans for key material, legal sign-off, replay harness.
Jordan Lee: Include index.json in package (request_id,timestamp,blob_path) and a manifest with checksums for integrity.
Samir Rao: Canary export for Dedicated tenants daily. Failures alert eng-ops and block GA.
KMS PM: I can deliver wrapped-key-thumbprint endpoint in ~2 weeks if prioritized.
Alex Chen: Actions: Maya draft schema v1 by Wed; Jordan prototype exporter + validator by Fri; Samir secure KMS commit; Luis add forbidden-pattern scanner; Alex schedule legal review next Tue.
Maya Patel: Risk: accidental key leakage; legal scope creep; search cost. Mitigations: automated validation, schema freeze, compact format.
Jordan Lee: Agree. Also enforce write-once for evidence blobs and RBAC on export retrieval.
Alex Chen: I'll write a short PRD and attach sample package layout. Closing — will link PRD here when ready. :thumbsup:
